newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile mining minister visits Europe, Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: Chile mining minister visits Europe, Kazakhstan.

text.p: Chilean Mining Minister Benjamin Teplizky has left for an 18-day trip to Finland, Russia, Kazakhstan and Italy to sign a series of cooperation agreements in geology and mining technology, a spokesman said.
He'll also meet with officials of companies with mining investments in Chile, including Finland's Outokumpu, the spokesman said.

"The goal of the trip is to strengthen commercial ties in the mining area, plus to study possibilities for reciprocal cooperation in geology, smelting, equipment, technology transfer and environmental issues," said Teplizky in a statement after leaving Thursday night.
He told reporters last week that officials in Kazakhstan were particularly interested in Chilean mining technology and developing cooperation ties.
Teplizky was due to return to Santiago on May 20.
